name: reverser-progress-graph
description: MCP server and call-graph generator for reverse engineering and reimplementing 16-bit MS-DOS programs

scripts.inspector: npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector --cli node build/index.js --disassembly-root "${REVERSER_DISASSEMBLY_ROOT:?set REVERSER_DISASSEMBLY_ROOT to a generated tree}" --protocol-era modern --method tools/list
scripts.inspector-webui: npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node build/index.js --disassembly-root "${REVERSER_DISASSEMBLY_ROOT:?set REVERSER_DISASSEMBLY_ROOT to a generated tree}" --protocol-era modern
